description: This file contains the implementation of the LeaveEntitlementService class, which manages leave entitlement operations such as retrieving leave balances, adding entitlements, and deleting entitlements within the OrangeHRM leave management module.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementService
classes.description: A service class managing leave entitlement data and operations such as retrieval, addition, and deletion, integrating various traits for auxiliary functionalities.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves and initializes the leave entitlement consumption strategy, either defaulting to FIFO or another configured strategy.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the Data Access Object for leave entitlements.

methods.name: getDeletableIdsFromEntitlementIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of leave entitlements that are safe to delete based on whether they have been used.

methods.name: isDeletable
methods.description: Determines if a given leave entitlement can be deleted (i.e., has no days used).

methods.name: getLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the leave balance for an employee, optionally at a specific date.

methods.name: addEntitlementForEmployee
methods.description: Adds or updates an entitlement for an employee within a leave period, handling both new and existing entitlements.

methods.name: bulkAssignLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Assigns leave entitlements to multiple employees in bulk, deploying a template entitlement object.
